definition_notes: D denotes the cap and tau the first hitting distance, infinity if unreachable. Two separate descriptive arms: min(D,tau) and min(D+1,tau); never min(D,tau+1).

The proposal Step1 uses E[min(tau,D)], whereas OBJECT FRAME uses min(D+1,tau). Frozen specification does not resolve this; predictions are scored only for explicitly labeled prediction-compatible arm.

Terminating path has map [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,7], stores[3,5],D4; cycle has map[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,0],store0,D3. These are prospectively concrete readings of path/cycle words, not retrospectively amended originals.

Spacing convention uses uniform residual offsets0,1,2,3 divided by spacing4; lambda-cost convention uses rho_p1 and L(1+lambda*rho_p), lambda0,1/100,1/10, for both arms. Coordinator must admit these explicit interpretations before launch.
